# Content Security Policy builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/csp-builder/

Compose a CSP header from explicit resource-source choices. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Start with a restrictive policy, add your actual script/image origins and choose report-only while testing.

## Limits and checks

A generated header needs deployment and testing. It does not audit your application or guarantee that every browser resource will load.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [MDN — Content Security Policy](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Guides/CSP)
